source_evidence: Exact player: 'Approach and ask: It’s a long way from the Iron Dominion. What your business in this part of the world?' V approaches openly along the track from screened bend toward H1; at about40ft separation (V at approximately0,45) H1 notices him and raises a hand to halt, V delivers exact chosen question. C/F/Mara accompany a few feet behind on road (approximately0,35–40), no forced weapons draw, no spell, no hiding or surprise assumed. H1 responds in Common, 'The Dominion? You think every hobgoblin serves the orc god?' Then says their business is surveying the old road and asks where V is going. H2 stops sketching, folds map and watches from existing shaded masonry; H3 remains at existing shaded flank, hand near darts. DM retains fixed independent motive of mapping usable upland routes for their own armed band and preventing witnesses compromising reconnaissance; no proven named employer or affiliation with Dominion, no automatic truthful denial beyond the actual words, no added troops, threats, invented regional state or compulsory battle. Canon world/politics/iron-dominion.md confirms independent goblinoids beyond Dominion. Hostility remains plausible if they judge party a threat; initial wary exchange is not a check to win cooperation, no initiative or attack yet. V next response. No new RNG, time advance beyond brief encounter dialogue, damage, resource, provisions, coin or custody change.
